subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep this as an operator-controlled workaround?
rationale: The code surface is small, but default browser launch flags affect all managed/server users and the existing shipped workaround already covers local managed profiles; live Chrome proof is still missing.

options.title: Prove, Then Add Headless Defaults
options.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Document Operator Control Only
options.body: Keep defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported mitigation.

options.title: Add A Dedicated Knob
options.body: Introduce a `browser.disableModelDownloads`-style option only if maintainers decide the existing config surface is insufficient despite the repo's high bar for new config.

recommendation.title: Prove, Then Add Headless Defaults
recommendation.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest browser-launch history and already reviewed the stale attempted fix path.
